docker_command:
docker run --device=/dev/davinci_manager --device=/dev/devmm_svm --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
  --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \
  -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:ro \
  --privileged --ipc=host -p 8000:8000 \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  -e HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024 \
  -e OMP_PROC_BIND=false \
  -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 \
  -e PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True \
  quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:latest Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --distributed_executor_backend mp \
  --async-scheduling \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
  --additional-config '{"weight_nz_mode":2}' \
  --quantization ascend

strategy_spec.name: single_node_tp
strategy_spec.description: Single-node tensor parallel. Splits the model across all local GPUs. TP size is set to the GPU count at deploy time. The simplest multi-GPU strategy — works for all model architectures.

hardware_profile.description: Ascend Atlas 800 A2 (CANN, 128 GB HBM) · 8-NPU training server node · vllm-ascend
